title: FOI Complaint Triage Output
description: Structured triage output for FOI requests, EIR requests, subject access requests, and complaints to UK public bodies

triage_id.description: Unique identifier for this triage output

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when triage was performed

extracted_asks.description: Distinct questions or requests extracted from the submission

summary.description: Brief summary of what is being asked

source_quote.description: Direct quote from the original text supporting this ask

specificity.description: How specific and answerable the ask is

date_range_specified.description: Whether the ask includes a specific date range

estimated_scope.description: Estimated scope of records that would need to be searched

rationale.description: Explanation of why this classification was chosen

indicators.description: Key phrases or indicators that led to this classification

suggested_department.description: Suggested department category to handle this request

suggested_team.description: Suggested team or function within the department

alternative_routes.description: Alternative routing options if primary is unavailable

external_referral_needed.description: Whether this may need referral to another public body

external_referral_suggestion.description: Suggested external body if referral needed

safeguarding_concern.description: Whether there are safeguarding concerns (vulnerability, risk to life, etc.)

safeguarding_details.description: Details of safeguarding concern if present

requires_immediate_human_review.description: Whether this needs immediate escalation to a human

escalation_reason.description: Reason for immediate escalation if required

legal_action_mentioned.description: Whether legal action is mentioned or implied

media_interest_indicated.description: Whether media interest is mentioned or implied

cost_limit_assessment.description: Assessment of whether the request may exceed FOI cost limits

likely_exceeds_limit.description: Whether the request is likely to exceed the appropriate cost limit (£450 for most public authorities, £600 for central government)

scope_concerns.description: Specific concerns about the breadth of the request

refinement_suggestions.description: Suggestions for how the requester could narrow their request

draft_clarification_letter.description: Draft clarification letter if needed, following ICO guidance (polite, no accusation of AI use)

bulk_submission_signals.description: Signals that this may be part of a bulk/template campaign (information only, never grounds for rejection)

signals.description: Specific signals detected (e.g., template language, campaign phrases)

note.default: This is informational only. Bulk/templated requests remain valid and must be processed according to FOI/EIR requirements.
note.description: Reminder that bulk signals do not affect validity

key_topics.description: Key topics or themes in the submission

model_version.description: Version of the triage model used

processing_mode.description: Whether this was processed in live or mock mode
